body:
WE #xykwe0h: build outcomes were recorded `orphan-released` for every Claude and agy build.

Cause: a `claude --bg` handle is a session id (not a pid) and the claim owner pid is the short-lived dispatching process, so orphan-adopt read every Claude build as dead one tick later and released it. A paused await-verify session looked dead too. The pre-dispatch already-done check only looked at merged PRs by title.

Fix (minimal; kept off the tick-overrun #4356 and prep-concurrency changes to `build-dispatch-daemon.mjs`, which this PR does not touch):
- `scripts/conveyor/build-delivery-evidence.mjs`: real delivery = PR on `lane/<num>-` (open or merged) or resolved card.
- orphan-adopt: a dead claim with delivery evidence settles as `pr-opened` / `pr-merged` / `card-resolved`, never `orphan-released`; a live job record or live await-verify record keeps the claim alive.
- dispatch-lane: new `build-delivered` gate refuses a build whose PR is open/merged or card resolved (build kind only).
- Allowlisted the branch-prefix `--search` in the no-search-backed-pr-list guard (same pattern as run-rating).
- Coroner: its build metrics read tick rows, not outcomes, so no change; its repeat-card rate falls once relaunches stop.

Tests are red on old code (replays of #4388->#4339, #4382, #5189 await-verify). verify-lane green.

Card: xykwe0h.

'').toLowerCase())` returns `{alive:true}` when `state.state` is missing, empty, or any value outside {done, stopped, failed, error}. A missing or empty state becomes `session-working`. The fix is also on the PR's own goal, so it cannot be parallelized. I could not run a mutation probe, because I worked from the diff text only. ## Before (red, new tests on the unfixed code)
`vitest run build-delivery-evidence / build-dispatch-orphan-adopt / no-search-backed-pr-list` → **15 failed | 92 passed**, e.g.
- `defaultSessionLiveness › a STALE working record … is not alive`

- `… the terminal state cancelled / killed is not alive`
- `prBelongsToBuild › a cross-repository (fork) PR is never delivery evidence`

## After (green)
Same files + `dispatch-lane.test.mjs` / `dispatch-lane-io.test.mjs`: **all pass** (405 in the wider run; 111 in the three touched suites after the self-review round). Harness verify: GREEN for `973b4cce`.

## What changed, per finding
1. **Stale / unknown session state read as alive** (`build-dispatch-orphan-adopt.mjs`): only an explicit active state (`working|running|idle|blocked`) with a fresh ISO `updatedAt` (30 min window; not future-dated beyond 5 min skew) is alive. Unknown/missing state or unreadable/future/non-ISO `updatedAt` → `null` (caller falls back to the owner pid). Stale-active or terminal → alive only if a live await-verify record parks the session. Terminal set gained `cancelled`, `killed`.
2. **Merged PR blocks a re-queued card forever** (`build-delivery-evidence.mjs`): a merged PR landing on a day strictly before the card's `dateOpened` (read from origin/main) is not delivery of this opening; unreadable date ignores nothing; open PRs always count. Semantics documented on `classifyBuildDelivery`.
3. **Fork PRs as delivery evidence**: `isCrossRepository` requested and `=== true` rejected before any branch/title match; `--limit` raised 20 → 100 so forks cannot crowd the real PR out of the page. Guard test now requires the file to request and honour `isCrossRepository`.
4. **Missing/unrecognized state treated as alive**: same fix as (1), parameterized tests for missing, empty, unrecognized.

## Variants considered
Defect class: evidence read from an untrusted/unbounded source is treated as proof (of life or of delivery).
- Variants fixed: unknown state; stale active state; terminal-state spellings; future `updatedAt`; non-ISO `updatedAt` (`"0"` parses as year 2000); `blocked` (a documented live state, found in self-review); fork PR by branch and by title; fork rows crowding a limited page; merged PR predating the card's reopen.
- Call sites: `defaultSessionLiveness` (one caller, `adoptOrphanedBuildClaims`); `defaultListBuildPrs` → `readBuildDelivery` (callers: orphan-adopt and `dispatch-lane-io.mjs` — both go through `classifyBuildDelivery`).
- Out of scope, **owed follow-up (not filed on this PR to keep its diff in scope)**: `backlog.mjs unresolve` keeps `dateOpened`, so a re-queue must restamp it by hand or the card stays held (hold reason names the merged PR). A card opened *after* its PR merged (retroactive card) would have the merge ignored.
